# @three-ws/shipfeed

> Turn a repo's raw commit history into a release feed humans actually read: conventional-commit parsing, audience classification, and changelog-to-commit provenance with no extra metadata.

@three-ws/shipfeed is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/shipfeed`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-shipfeed/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-shipfeed/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-shipfeed/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-shipfeed/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
